name: ckz_eff2500_init_strength_fine
_design: Pin the strength-grid finding: in the init regime LOWER LoRA strength (0.85) beat 1.0, and over-applying (1.15) + high noise (0.75) were worse. But it was marginal/seed-driven (T4M4 seed7 only). Fix noise=0.6 (the winning anchor), sweep LoRA strength [0.75/0.85/0.95] across 2 dense loops (dark128, monster80) x 2 seeds to confirm 'lower-LoRA-helps-with-init' is robust, not a fluke. Best recipe candidate = dense full loop + noise 0.6 + str ~0.85. Rate timbre+melody+note.
